description: We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead a premier health and rehabilitation center in Baltimore County, MD. This is a confidential opportunity for a visionary leader dedicated to operational excellence and delivering exceptional patient care. Join a team committed to fostering a supportive environment for both residents and staff.As the LNHA, you will be responsible for the overall management and success of the facility, ensuring compliance with all regulatory standards and driving continuous improvement in quality of care and resident satisfaction. This role offers a significant opportunity to make a profound impact on the lives of residents and the professional growth of your team.We offer a competitive annual salary ranging from $115,000 to $145,000, commensurate with your experience and leadership capabilities. If you are a results-oriented administrator with a passion for healthcare, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Active Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland
Proven experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting
Strong leadership and operational management skills
In-depth knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $115,000 - $145,000, compensation based on experience.
